title: Swedish legal AI firm Legora raises $550M led by Atreides at $8.8B valuation
content:
Swedish legal AI startup Legora has raised $550 million in a Series E funding round, bringing its valuation to $8.8 billion. US investment firm Atreides Management led the round, with several new and existing investors participating.
Five new investors joined the round: Baron Capital, Capital Group, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Glade Brook Capital Partners, and J.P. Morgan. Existing backers, including Accel, Benchmark, General Catalyst, ICONIQ, and Salesforce Ventures, also invested.
Legora plans to use the money to expand across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, while continuing to develop its legal AI platform, Legora aOS. Its tools help legal teams research, track changes in legislation, and handle incoming requests through AI agents.
The company says its annual recurring revenue (ARR) has now passed $200 million. Legora says it took less than 18 months to grow from $1 million to $100 million in revenue, then less than six months to add another $100 million.
More than 140,000 legal professionals across over 2,400 law firms and in-house legal teams now use its software in more than 80 markets. In-house legal departments accounted for over 40% of new customers in the third quarter.
The US has become Legora’s largest market by revenue. The company said more than half of the AmLaw 50, a ranking of the 50 highest-grossing law firms in the US, are now customers. Legora opened its first US office in spring 2025.
Founded in 2023, Legora launched its platform in October 2024. It now has more than 1,000 employees across 18 offices, seven of them in North America.
“The opportunity in legal is enormous and we are still early. AI is changing the role of the lawyer, with more time for judgment and advice, and it is reshaping how law firms and in-house legal teams are organized and how their work gets done,” said co-founder and CEO Max Junestrand.
CFO David Eckstein said the company was focused on making sure its rapid expansion was supported by a sustainable business. Atreides managing partner Gavin Baker also praised Legora’s ability to grow while building a business designed to last.
“Growth only counts if the business underneath it holds up. We have passed $200 million in ARR, and we want every dollar of it to be a durable one. That means healthy gross margins, high retention, and a cost structure that gets stronger as we scale. This round lets us keep building that way,” said David Eckstein, CFO at Legora.
The funding comes just six weeks after US rival Harvey raised $550 million at a $15.5 billion valuation, according to Legal Business.
Both companies are competing to bring AI tools into law firms and corporate legal departments, as investors continue to back software designed to automate parts of legal work.

report.summary: 瑞典法律AI公司Legora融资5.5亿美元，估值88亿美元
report.background: 法律AI正成为企业软件最热的赛道之一。Legora 2023年在斯德哥尔摩成立，2024年10月才正式上线平台，主打用AI代理帮律师做法律检索、追踪立法变化和处理日常请求。仅六周前，美国对手Harvey刚以155亿美元估值融资5.5亿美元，两家公司正竞相把AI送进律所和企业法务部门。此轮由美国Atreides Management领投，Fidelity、Capital Group、摩根大通等新面孔入场，说明公开市场风格的长期资金也开始押注垂直AI应用。
key_points: 收入增速罕见：年化经常性收入已超2亿美元，从100万到1亿美元用了不到18个月，之后再加1亿美元只用了不到6个月。
客户基础扎实：全球80多个市场、2400多家律所和企业法务团队、超14万法律从业者在使用，美国已是其最大收入来源市场。
头部客户渗透：美国营收前50的律所（AmLaw 50）中超过一半已成为客户，企业法务部门贡献了第三季度新增客户的四成以上。
钱花在扩张上：融资将用于北美、欧洲、亚太三地扩张与Legora aOS平台研发，公司现有员工超1000人、18个办公室。
管理层强调质量：CFO称已跨过2亿美元ARR，但更看重毛利率、留存率和规模化后的成本结构，而非单纯增速。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，法律成为继编程之后第二个被验证的垂直AI大市场，单赛道出现两家百亿美元级公司，会带动资本继续涌入金融、医疗、审计等专业服务领域，也加剧“估值是否过热”的争论。对开发者，机会不在于重做一个通用模型，而在于把AI代理、检索增强、合规审计和行业工作流做深，法律领域的评测、数据治理和可追溯性会成为关键技术门槛。对普通用户，最直接的变化是法律服务成本下降、响应变快，但AI输出的准确性与责任归属仍是隐忧。
report.tools: 想跟进可关注商用产品Legora与Harvey的实际功能设计；开源侧可用LlamaIndex、LangChain或Haystack搭建法律文档RAG，结合Open Contracts做开源合同分析，用CUAD等法律合同数据集和LegalBench评测基准检验效果，重点打磨引用溯源与人工复核流程。
